1.bug_scenario:
When opening the Grommet v2 Calendar in IE11 (https://v2.grommet.io/calendar), the date-picker pop-out renders its days grid completely broken:
- Many day numbers don’t render or are misaligned
- The header chevron icons disappear or collapse
- The month title, day cells, and background styling are corrupted

This is clearly an IE11–only rendering issue (Safari/Chrome are unaffected) likely caused by Calendar’s use of modern CSS (grid, flex, custom properties) or styled-components patterns that IE11 doesn’t fully support.
